therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Enhanced anti-lymphoma activity through dual targeting of tumor cells and immune microenvironment
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with relapsed/refractory indolent non-Hodgkin's lymphoma (follicular lymphoma and marginal zone lymphoma)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Progression-free survival assessed by Independent Review Committee

safety_signals: Grade 3/4 adverse events more common in combination arm (121/176 vs 58/180)
More dose reductions and interruptions with lenalidomide
Serious adverse events higher in combination arm (45/176 vs 25/180)
results.dose_information: Lenalidomide 20mg PO daily days 1-21 every 28 days up to 12 cycles; Rituximab 375mg/m2 IV weekly in cycle 1, then day 1 of cycles 2-5

context.duration: Median treatment duration 11.19 months (combination) vs 11.04 months (control); median follow-up 28.30 months
